description: This Java source file defines the RxSharedPrefs class, which manages application preferences using reactive programming with RxJava and RxPreferences. It includes methods for retrieving preferences, upgrading settings, and applying auto preferences files, as well as an inner class for providing preferences via SharedPreferences.

classes.name: RxSharedPrefs
classes.description: Main class managing reactive shared preferences, including upgrade logic, auto-apply from files, and preference retrieval methods.

classes.name: SharedPrefsProvider
classes.description: Inner class implementing PrefsProvider interface, providing methods to get and store preferences using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: upgradeSettingsValues
methods.description: Performs upgrade logic on SharedPreferences, updating keys and values based on version.

methods.name: applyAutoPrefsFile
methods.description: Checks for an external preferences file and applies its contents if available.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean preference with a resource key and default value.

methods.name: getInteger
methods.description: Retrieves an integer preference with a resource key and default value.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string preference with a resource key and default value.

methods.name: getParsedString
methods.description: Retrieves a preference string and parses it into a custom type using a provided parser.

methods.name: getStringSet
methods.description: Retrieves a set of strings preference.
